verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships an official `gz` command-line tool. It is used to launch simulations (`gz sim shapes.sdf`) and offers documented flags for server-only/headless mode (-s), GUI-only mode (-g) and verbosity (-v 4). The project also advertises 'extensive command line tools for increased simulation introspection and control' and command-line tools for Gazebo Fuel. These cover the core of a scriptable official CLI that an agent could drive, especially with the headless/CI server package. Missing for 10: a documented full CLI reference for the introspection/control subcommands, AI-native ergonomics such as machine-readable/JSON output or agent-oriented usage guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
